target: KTP saya hilang minggu lalu, sekarang saya harus mengurus kartu pengganti.
english: My ID card went missing last week; now I have to sort out a replacement card.
grammar: Mengurus = to take care of (paperwork): mengurus KTP baru = sort out a new ID card. THE bureaucracy verb.

target: Sebelum meminta KTP baru, saya harus melaporkan kehilangannya ke kantor polisi.
english: Before asking for a new ID card, I have to report the loss to the police station.

target: Petugas bilang blanko KTP sedang habis, jadi saya cuma dapat surat keterangan.
english: The clerk said the blank ID cards had run out, so I only got a certificate.
grammar: Surat keterangan = an official note standing in for a document: surat keterangan hilang = certificate of loss.

target: Foto di KTP saya sudah lama sekali, mukanya beda dengan sekarang.
english: The photo on my ID card is really old; the face looks different from now.

target: Alamat di KTP saya masih alamat rumah lama di Bandung.
english: The address on my ID card is still my old home address in Bandung.

target: Kalau pindah rumah, data di kartu keluarga juga harus diubah.
english: If you move house, the data on the family card has to be changed too.
grammar: Kartu keluarga (KK) lists every household member — data di KK harus diubah = the KK data must be changed.

target: Kartu keluarga kami belum diubah setelah adik saya lahir.
english: Our family card hasn't been changed yet since my younger sibling was born.

target: Nama anak baru bisa masuk kartu keluarga setelah akta kelahirannya jadi.
english: A child's name can only go on the family card after their birth certificate is ready.
grammar: Jadi also means 'ready, done' for documents: aktanya sudah jadi = the certificate is ready.

target: Saya mengantre dari jam tujuh pagi untuk mencetak ulang KTP yang rusak.
english: I've been queuing since seven in the morning to reprint my damaged ID card.

target: KTP saya patah jadi dua karena dompet sering diduduki.
english: My ID card snapped in two because my wallet often gets sat on.

target: Petugas memeriksa data saya, lalu bilang semuanya sudah cocok.
english: The clerk checked my data, then said everything already matched.

target: Data e-KTP saya harus direkam ulang karena fotonya buram.
english: My e-KTP data has to be recorded again because the photo is blurry.

target: Kata petugas, KTP elektronik sekarang berlaku seumur hidup.
english: According to the clerk, the electronic ID card is now valid for life.
grammar: Seumur hidup = for life: berlaku seumur hidup = valid for life. Umur = age, lifetime.

target: Sistemnya sedang ada gangguan, jadi saya disuruh balik lagi besok.
english: The system is having problems, so I was told to come back again tomorrow.
grammar: Balik lagi besok = come back again tomorrow — the classic counter phrase. Balik = go back.

target: Ada satu angka yang salah di nomor KTP baru saya.
english: There's one wrong digit in my new ID card number.

target: Untung fotokopi KTP lama saya masih tersimpan di rumah.
english: Luckily a photocopy of my old ID card is still kept at home.

target: Untuk urusan surat pindah, saya harus meminta surat pengantar dari RT dulu.
english: For the moving papers, I first have to ask the RT for a cover letter.
grammar: RT is the neighborhood unit; its head (Pak RT) signs your surat pengantar = cover letter for paperwork.

target: Pak RT baru pulang kerja malam, jadi saya ke rumahnya setelah makan malam.
english: The RT head only gets home from work at night, so I went to his house after dinner.

target: Surat pengantar dari RT harus dicap dulu oleh RW sebelum dibawa ke kelurahan.
english: The cover letter from the RT has to be stamped by the RW first before being taken to the ward office.
grammar: Cap = official stamp: dicap = to get stamped. No cap, no service.

target: Kantor kelurahan buka jam delapan, tapi loketnya sering baru jalan jam sembilan.
english: The ward office opens at eight, but the counter often only gets going at nine.

target: Saya salah datang ke kecamatan, padahal suratnya diurus di kelurahan.
english: I went to the district office by mistake, even though the letter is handled at the ward office.

target: Ibu itu bingung karena disuruh bolak-balik antara kelurahan dan kecamatan.
english: That lady is confused because she was told to go back and forth between the ward and district offices.
grammar: Bolak-balik = back and forth: disuruh bolak-balik = told to go back and forth. Doubling adds repetition.

target: Petugas kelurahan meminta fotokopi kartu keluarga dua lembar.
english: The ward office clerk asked for two photocopies of the family card.

target: Berkas saya kurang satu, jadi harus balik lagi besok pagi.
english: My paperwork is one document short, so I have to come back again tomorrow morning.

target: Sebelum jam istirahat, ambil dulu nomor antrean di depan loket.
english: Before the break hour, first take a queue number in front of the counter.

target: Loket pelayanan tutup jam dua belas untuk istirahat siang.
english: The service counter closes at twelve for the midday break.

target: Surat keterangan domisili saya akhirnya jadi setelah tiga hari kerja.
english: My certificate of residence was finally ready after three working days.
grammar: Hari kerja = working day: tiga hari kerja = three working days — weekends don't count.

target: Tanda tangan lurah baru bisa didapat hari Senin karena beliau sedang dinas luar.
english: The ward head's signature can only be gotten on Monday because he is away on official duty.
grammar: Beliau = respectful he/she for elders and officials: beliau sedang rapat = he/she is in a meeting.

target: Semua berkas sudah lengkap, tinggal menunggu dipanggil petugas.
english: All the papers are complete; all that's left is waiting to be called by the clerk.
grammar: Tinggal + verb = all that's left is: tinggal menunggu = just have to wait.

target: Warga desa bisa meminta surat keterangan tidak mampu untuk biaya sekolah anak.
english: Villagers can request a low-income certificate for their children's school costs.

target: Paspor saya habis masa berlakunya bulan depan, harus segera diperpanjang.
english: My passport expires next month; it has to be renewed right away.
grammar: Masa berlaku = validity period: masa berlakunya habis = it has expired (lit. its validity is used up).

target: Sekarang antrean paspor diambil lewat aplikasi, bukan datang langsung ke kantor.
english: These days the passport queue slot is taken via an app, not by coming straight to the office.

target: Saya pilih jadwal wawancara paspor hari Kamis jam sepuluh pagi.
english: I picked a passport interview slot on Thursday at ten in the morning.

target: Jangan lupa bawa KTP asli dan kartu keluarga waktu mengurus paspor.
english: Don't forget to bring your original ID card and family card when sorting out your passport.

target: Petugas imigrasi menanyakan rencana perjalanan saya ke Jepang.
english: The immigration officer asked about my travel plans to Japan.

target: Setelah difoto dan diambil sidik jarinya, saya tinggal menunggu kabar dari kantor imigrasi.
english: After being photographed and fingerprinted, I just have to wait for word from the immigration office.
grammar: Sidik jari = fingerprint (lit. finger trace): diambil sidik jarinya = had their fingerprints taken.

target: Paspor baru bisa diambil empat hari kerja setelah pembayaran.
english: The new passport can be picked up four working days after payment.

target: Biaya paspor biasa lebih murah daripada paspor elektronik.
english: The fee for a regular passport is cheaper than an electronic passport.

target: Nama di paspor harus sama persis dengan nama di akta kelahiran.
english: The name in the passport has to be exactly the same as the name on the birth certificate.
grammar: Persis = exactly: sama persis = exactly the same. Stronger than plain sama.

target: Halaman paspor saya hampir penuh dengan cap dari berbagai negara.
english: My passport pages are almost full of stamps from various countries.

target: Anak di bawah umur perlu surat izin orang tua untuk membuat paspor.
english: A minor needs a parental permission letter to make a passport.

target: Kantor imigrasi penuh sekali menjelang musim haji dan liburan sekolah.
english: The immigration office is really packed ahead of the hajj season and school holidays.

target: Paspor lama tetap dikembalikan, tapi ujungnya sudah digunting.
english: The old passport is still returned, but its corner has been cut off.

target: Umur tujuh belas tahun sudah boleh bikin SIM di Indonesia.
english: At seventeen you're already allowed to get a driver's license in Indonesia.
grammar: Bikin = everyday 'make, get made': bikin SIM = get a license made. Casual but heard everywhere.

target: Sebelum tes, mata saya diperiksa dulu di klinik dekat kantor polisi.
english: Before the test, my eyes were checked first at a clinic near the police station.

target: Saya lulus ujian teori, tapi gagal di ujian praktik motor.
english: I passed the theory exam but failed the motorbike practical exam.

target: Jalur ujian praktiknya sempit sekali, banyak orang jatuh di belokan.
english: The practical test track is really narrow; lots of people fall at the curve.

target: Dia baru lulus ujian praktik setelah mencoba tiga kali.
english: He only passed the practical exam after trying three times.

target: SIM saya mati dua bulan lalu, jadi harus bikin baru dari awal.
english: My license expired two months ago, so I have to get a new one from scratch.
grammar: Documents 'die' in Indonesian: SIM saya mati = my license has expired. Habis works too.

target: Sekarang SIM bisa diperpanjang lewat mobil layanan SIM keliling dekat pasar.
english: Nowadays a license can be renewed through the mobile SIM service van near the market.
grammar: SIM keliling = mobile license-renewal van (keliling = go around). Renew without the police station.

target: Bawa SIM lama, KTP, dan hasil tes kesehatan waktu memperpanjang SIM.
english: Bring your old license, ID card, and health test results when renewing your license.

target: Foto dan sidik jari diambil lagi setiap kali memperpanjang SIM.
english: Your photo and fingerprints are taken again every time you renew your license.

target: Kalau menyetir mobil tanpa SIM, kamu bisa kena denda besar.
english: If you drive a car without a license, you can get a big fine.

target: SIM A untuk mobil, SIM C untuk sepeda motor.
english: A class-A license is for cars, a class-C license is for motorbikes.
grammar: SIM A = car license, SIM C = motorbike. Letters, not numbers, mark the classes.

target: Dompet saya ketinggalan di rumah, untung tidak ada razia hari ini.
english: My wallet got left at home; luckily there's no traffic check today.

target: Warung fotokopi di depan kantor kelurahan selalu ramai pagi hari.
english: The photocopy shop in front of the ward office is always busy in the morning.

target: Tolong fotokopi KTP ini tiga lembar, ya.
english: Please make three copies of this ID card, okay?

target: Semua berkas difotokopi dua kali, satu untuk arsip, satu untuk saya.
english: All the papers get photocopied twice: one set for the archive, one for me.

target: Surat pernyataan ini harus ditempel materai sepuluh ribu.
english: This statement letter has to have a ten-thousand duty stamp stuck on it.
grammar: Materai = duty stamp stuck on official statements to make them binding. Sold at post offices.

target: Materai bisa dibeli di kantor pos atau warung fotokopi.
english: Duty stamps can be bought at the post office or the photocopy shop.

target: Sebagian tanda tangan harus kena di atas materai.
english: Part of the signature has to land on the duty stamp.

target: Ijazah saya perlu dilegalisir di kampus sebelum dipakai melamar kerja.
english: My diploma needs to be certified at the campus before being used to apply for jobs.
grammar: Dilegalisir = certified as a true copy: ijazah dilegalisir kampus = diploma certified by the campus.

target: Mesin fotokopinya rusak, jadi saya jalan ke toko alat tulis di seberang.
english: The photocopier is broken, so I walked to the stationery shop across the street.

target: Simpan salinan semua dokumen penting di rumah dan di email.
english: Keep copies of all important documents at home and in your email.

target: Harga fotokopi di sini masih lima ratus rupiah per lembar.
english: The price of photocopies here is still five hundred rupiah per sheet.

target: Saya baru mendaftar BPJS Kesehatan lewat aplikasi di ponsel.
english: I just registered for BPJS health insurance through the app on my phone.
grammar: BPJS Kesehatan is the national health insurance; nearly every resident is a member.

target: Iuran BPJS dibayar sebelum tanggal sepuluh setiap bulan.
english: The BPJS premium is paid before the tenth of every month.

target: Kalau iuran telat, kartunya tidak bisa dipakai di rumah sakit.
english: If the premium is late, the card can't be used at the hospital.

target: Semua anggota keluarga harus didaftarkan BPJS, tidak bisa satu orang saja.
english: All family members have to be registered for BPJS; it can't be just one person.

target: Pilih dulu klinik terdekat sebagai tempat berobat pertama kamu.
english: First choose the nearest clinic as your primary place for treatment.
grammar: Berobat = to seek treatment: berobat ke klinik = go to the clinic for treatment. Obat = medicine.

target: Sebelum ke rumah sakit besar, pasien BPJS harus meminta rujukan dari klinik.
english: Before going to a big hospital, BPJS patients have to ask the clinic for a referral.
grammar: Rujukan = referral: meminta rujukan = ask for a referral. Clinic first, hospital second.

target: Kartu BPJS sekarang bisa ditunjukkan lewat aplikasi, tidak perlu kartu fisik.
english: The BPJS card can now be shown via the app; no physical card needed.

target: Kelas rawat BPJS menentukan kamar yang kamu dapat di rumah sakit.
english: Your BPJS care class determines the room you get at the hospital.

target: Bayi harus didaftarkan BPJS paling lambat dua puluh delapan hari setelah lahir.
english: Babies have to be registered for BPJS at the latest twenty-eight days after birth.

target: Nomor BPJS saya tertulis di belakang kartu lama.
english: My BPJS number is written on the back of the old card.

target: Kantor BPJS penuh di awal bulan, lebih baik datang siang.
english: The BPJS office is packed at the start of the month; better to come at midday.

target: Saya mau membuka rekening baru, syaratnya apa saja, ya?
english: I'd like to open a new account; what are the requirements?
grammar: Syarat = requirement: syaratnya apa saja? = what are the requirements? Ask this before any queue.

target: Cukup bawa KTP dan uang setoran awal seratus ribu rupiah.
english: Just bring your ID card and an initial deposit of one hundred thousand rupiah.

target: Petugas bank membantu saya mengisi formulir pembukaan rekening.
english: The bank clerk helped me fill in the account-opening form.

target: Pilih rekening tanpa biaya bulanan kalau tabungan kamu masih kecil.
english: Choose an account without monthly fees if your savings are still small.

target: Kartu ATM dan buku tabungan diberikan langsung hari itu juga.
english: The ATM card and savings book are handed over that very same day.
grammar: Hari itu juga = that very same day. Juga after a time phrase adds 'right then'.

target: Jangan kasih tahu nomor PIN kamu ke siapa pun, termasuk petugas bank.
english: Don't tell your PIN number to anyone at all, including bank staff.
grammar: Siapa pun = anyone at all: jangan kasih tahu siapa pun = don't tell anyone. Pun strengthens.

target: Saldo minimal rekening ini lima puluh ribu rupiah.
english: The minimum balance for this account is fifty thousand rupiah.

target: Kartu ATM saya tertelan mesin, jadi harus melapor ke kantor cabang.
english: My ATM card got swallowed by the machine, so I have to report it to the branch office.
grammar: Ter- marks accidents: tertelan = accidentally swallowed (by the machine), ketinggalan = left behind.

target: Rekening bisa diblokir sementara kalau kartunya hilang.
english: The account can be temporarily blocked if the card goes missing.

target: Sekarang membuka rekening juga bisa dari rumah lewat aplikasi bank.
english: These days opening an account can also be done from home through the bank's app.

target: Bunga tabungan biasa kecil sekali, hampir tidak terasa.
english: The interest on a regular savings account is tiny; you hardly notice it.

target: Transfer antar bank kena biaya dua ribu lima ratus rupiah.
english: Transfers between banks incur a fee of two thousand five hundred rupiah.

target: Mesin ATM di dekat kampus sering kehabisan uang di akhir pekan.
english: The ATM near campus often runs out of cash on weekends.

target: Simpan bukti transfer sampai uangnya benar-benar masuk.
english: Keep the transfer receipt until the money has really arrived.
grammar: Benar-benar = really, truly: benar-benar masuk = has really arrived. Doubling intensifies.

target: Visa turis saya cuma berlaku tiga puluh hari.
english: My tourist visa is only valid for thirty days.

target: Visa saya bisa diperpanjang satu kali di kantor imigrasi terdekat.
english: My visa can be extended once at the nearest immigration office.

target: Teman saya kena denda karena tinggal lewat dari batas visanya.
english: My friend got fined for staying past his visa limit.
grammar: Kena = to get hit with (bad things): kena denda = get fined, kena flu = catch the flu.

target: Untuk kerja di Indonesia, kamu perlu KITAS, bukan visa turis.
english: To work in Indonesia, you need a KITAS, not a tourist visa.
grammar: KITAS = temporary stay permit card for foreigners who work or live in Indonesia. Visa turis won't do.

target: KITAS karyawan asing biasanya diurus oleh perusahaan sponsor.
english: A foreign employee's KITAS is usually handled by the sponsoring company.

target: Proses perpanjangan visa makan waktu sekitar lima hari kerja.
english: The visa extension process takes about five working days.
grammar: Makan waktu = to take time (lit. eat time): prosesnya makan waktu lima hari = it takes five days.

target: Saya harus datang sendiri ke imigrasi untuk foto dan sidik jari.
english: I have to come to immigration in person for the photo and fingerprints.

target: Periksa dulu halaman kosong di paspor sebelum mengurus perpanjangan visa.
english: First check the blank pages in your passport before sorting out a visa extension.

target: Waktu visanya habis, dia keluar ke Singapura lalu masuk lagi.
english: When his visa ran out, he exited to Singapore and then came back in.

target: Petugas imigrasi meminta bukti tiket pulang dan alamat penginapan.
english: The immigration officer asked for proof of a return ticket and the address of my accommodation.

target: Biaya perpanjangan visa dibayar lewat kode pembayaran di bank.
english: The visa extension fee is paid via a payment code at the bank.

target: Pemegang KITAS bisa membuka rekening bank dan membuat SIM lokal.
english: KITAS holders can open a bank account and get a local driver's license.

target: Pendaftaran sekolah negeri dibuka bulan Juni setiap tahun.
english: Registration for public schools opens in June every year.

target: Kami mendaftarkan anak ke sekolah dekat rumah lewat jalur zonasi.
english: We registered our child at a school near home through the zoning track.
grammar: Jalur zonasi = school placement by home distance: lewat jalur zonasi = via the zoning track.

target: Syarat daftar SD antara lain akta kelahiran dan kartu keluarga.
english: The requirements for elementary school registration include a birth certificate and the family card.
grammar: Antara lain = among others: syaratnya antara lain KTP = the requirements include an ID card.

target: Umur anak minimal enam tahun untuk masuk kelas satu SD.
english: A child has to be at least six years old to enter first grade of elementary school.

target: Ibu itu menyiapkan rapor dan fotokopi ijazah untuk pendaftaran SMP anaknya.
english: That mother is preparing the report card and diploma photocopies for her child's junior high registration.

target: Pengumuman hasil seleksi bisa dilihat di papan sekolah atau situs resmi.
english: The selection results announcement can be seen on the school board or the official website.

target: Anak yang diterima harus mendaftar ulang paling lambat hari Jumat.
english: Children who are accepted have to re-register by Friday at the latest.
grammar: Daftar ulang = re-register to claim your seat (ulang = again). Miss it and the spot is gone.

target: Waktu daftar ulang, anak saya diukur untuk seragam sekolah baru.
english: At re-registration, my child was measured for the new school uniform.

target: Sekolah meminta pas foto anak ukuran tiga kali empat, dua lembar.
english: The school asked for two of the child's ID photos, size three by four.
grammar: Pas foto = ID photo; sizes are in cm: tiga kali empat = 3x4. Standard for every form.

target: Tahun ajaran baru dimulai pertengahan Juli setelah libur panjang.
english: The new school year starts in mid-July after the long holiday.

target: Kalau berkasnya kurang, panitia pendaftaran akan menghubungi lewat telepon.
english: If the papers are incomplete, the registration committee will get in touch by phone.

target: Orang tua murid baru diundang ke pertemuan perkenalan minggu depan.
english: Parents of new students are invited to an introduction meeting next week.

target: Ambil nomor antrean dari mesin, lalu duduk menunggu dipanggil.
english: Take a queue number from the machine, then sit and wait to be called.

target: Nomor antrean saya masih jauh, jadi saya sempat keluar mencari sarapan.
english: My queue number was still far off, so I had time to go out and find breakfast.

target: Loket empat memanggil nomor seratus dua, tapi orangnya sudah pergi.
english: Counter four called number one hundred two, but the person had already left.

target: Kalau nomormu terlewat, kamu harus mengambil nomor baru lagi.
english: If your number gets skipped, you have to take a new number again.
grammar: Terlewat = accidentally passed, missed: nomormu terlewat = your number got skipped.

target: Datang setengah jam sebelum kantor buka supaya dapat antrean awal.
english: Come half an hour before the office opens so you get an early queue spot.

target: Bapak di sebelah saya sudah tiga kali ke sini untuk berkas yang sama.
english: The man next to me has already been here three times for the same paperwork.

target: Petugasnya ramah, tapi aturannya memang tidak bisa ditawar.
english: The clerk is friendly, but the rules really can't be bargained with.

target: Jangan pakai jasa calo, biayanya jadi dua kali lipat.
english: Don't use a fixer's services; the cost becomes double.
grammar: Calo = tout who 'helps' with tickets or paperwork for a fee: pakai jasa calo = use a fixer.

target: Semua pengurusan dokumen di kantor ini sebenarnya gratis.
english: All document processing at this office is actually free.

target: Pelayanan hari ini sampai jam tiga saja karena ada rapat kantor.
english: Service today is only until three o'clock because there's an office meeting.

target: Akhirnya semua dokumen saya selesai, rasanya lega sekali.
english: Finally all my documents are done; it feels like such a relief.
